notes: Perplexity first-party Decisions API price: $0.02 per million input tokens, output tokens free, no per-request fee (pricing page Decisions table, 2026-11-26; the 2026-10 quickstart sentence quoting these figures was removed from the quickstart, which now covers install and a first request only). Rate limit 10 requests per second per organization, every plan (Decisions docs page). PRICE CONFLICT: Requesty still lists perplexity/pplx-decider-v1-27b at $0.04 per million input tokens (2x the direct price); OpenRouter no longer lists the v1-27b id at all, and its current decider ids (pplx-decider-v1.2/v1.3, flash, latest aliases) bill at $0.02 or less per million input tokens, matching the direct price. Unresolved whether Requesty adds a markup or its listing is stale; both are recorded (see the openrouter and requesty pricing docs). pplx-decider-v1.1-27b is a legacy alias of pplx-decider-v1-27b; the v1 and v1.1 rows are the same rate. Cache fields: cache_read_per_m and cache_write_per_m are null with cache_rates_status "not_published": the vendor documents no caching discount or surcharge, so no cache rate is recorded (none is inferred from the input price). 2026-11-26 re-read: 12 figures compared, 1 changed — OpenRouter conflict figure old $0.04 per million input tokens no longer stated (pplx-decider-v1-27b delisted from the OpenRouter decisions catalog; current OpenRouter decider ids bill at $0.02 or less per million input tokens); all other figures unchanged ($0.02 input both rows, free output, no per-request fee, 10 req/s per org, cache not published, Requesty $0.04/M listing and $0.023 per 1,000 items billed).

pplx-decider-v1-27b.notes: Direct price. 10 requests/s per org. Requesty measured a billed $0.023 per 1,000 items (about $0.02) on its gateway benchmark through the router.

pplx-decider-v1.1-27b.notes: Same Decisions API; the quickstart does not list a separate v1.1 rate.
